info.title: Fusion Checkout API
info.description:
Test keys (`fsk_test_…`) create sandbox payments, live keys live ones; the key decides, on the same host.

Every error is `{ error: { code, message, statusCode, details?, hint, docUrl } }`:

| code | what to do |
|---|---|
| `invalid_request` | A field broke a rule: `details` names it and the rule. |
| `invalid_body` | Send a JSON object with Content-Type: application/json. |
| `payload_too_large` | Keep the body under 64 KiB; metadata is at most 50 short pairs. |
| `card_data_not_allowed` | Never send card numbers to Fusion, in metadata or anywhere else: the customer enters them on the gateway's page. |
| `invalid_api_key` | Use a secret key (fsk_test_… or fsk_live_…) from the dashboard, as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. |
| `publishable_key_not_allowed` | Server calls need the secret key (fsk_…), never the publishable one. |
| `not_found` | Check the method and path against the API reference. |
| `payment_not_found` | Check the id, and that the key is the same project and mode (test or live) as the payment. |
| `event_not_found` | Check the id, and that the key is the same project and mode (test or live) as the event. |
| `merchant_reference_taken` | Each payment of a project and mode needs its own merchantReference. |
| `idempotency_in_progress` | A request with this Idempotency-Key is still running: retry in a few seconds. |
| `idempotency_key_reused` | An Idempotency-Key names one request: use a new key for a different body. |
| `amount_too_large` | Split the amount, or ask Fusion to raise the project's limit for this currency. |
| `currency_not_supported` | Use a currency one of the project's gateways takes (sandbox: NGN, USD, GHS, GBP), or enable the gateway for it. |
| `no_eligible_gateway` | `details` says why each gateway was left out: turn one on, or widen `gateways`. |
| `rate_limited` | Wait Retry-After seconds, then retry; spread bursts out. |
| `internal_error` | Retry with the same Idempotency-Key; contact support with `details.requestId` if it persists. |

servers.description: Production: sandbox with a test key (fsk_test_…), live with a live key (fsk_live_…)

secretKey.description: Your secret key. The key decides the mode on the same host: fsk_test_… makes sandbox payments, fsk_live_… live ones.

post.description: Creates a payment and its hosted checkout page (`url`): send the customer there. No gateway is called yet; the customer picks one on the page. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header (1–255 characters) to make retries safe: the same key and body return the first payment (with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`), another body with the key is refused.

amountMinor.description: Integer minor units of `currency` (kobo for NGN): ₦5,000.00 is 500000.

currency.description: ISO 4217, upper case. Sandbox: NGN, USD, GHS, GBP; live: NGN.

redirectUrl.description: Where the customer returns, with `payment_id` and `reference` added. Never trust it as proof: verify the payment. https in live.

merchantReference.description: Your own id for the payment; unique per project and mode.

gateways.description: Only these gateways, if eligible. Narrows the project's list; never adds or reorders.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the payment expires: 300 to 86400, default 1800.

metadata.description: The merchant's own key-value pairs: at most 50; keys of letters, digits, _ - . (≤ 40); values ≤ 500.

url.description: The hosted checkout page: send the customer here.

fusionReference.description: `FUS-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX`: shown to the customer and on the gateway.

gateway.description: The gateway of the successful attempt.

gateways.description: Gateways this payment can be paid with, in priority order.

gatewayReference.description: The reference Fusion sent the gateway (FUS-…-n).

processorRef.description: The gateway's second id, e.g. Flutterwave flw_ref. Quote it to gateway support.

feeMinor.description: Integer minor units, in the payment's currency.

lateSuccessAt.description: Set when this attempt turned out paid after it had ended (switched away from, abandoned, canceled or expired).

metadata.description: The merchant's own key-value pairs: at most 50; keys of letters, digits, _ - . (≤ 40); values ≤ 500.

version.description: Increments on every status change; order webhooks by it.

duplicateCharge.description: The customer paid twice (a second attempt was paid after this payment succeeded): refund one at the gateway.

get.description: The project's payments in the key's mode, newest first.

post.description: Use it after the customer returns to your `redirectUrl`: the return itself proves nothing. A payment still open is checked with its gateway (at most once every 10 seconds; inside that, the stored state) and returned as Fusion now knows it. When the gateway cannot say, the stored state is returned: verify again later.
